halves.title: All nations blessed through Abraham's offspring
halves.quote: And you are sons of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers when He said to Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all the families of the earth will be blessed.’

halves.title: All nations blessed through Abraham's offspring
halves.quote: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. The Scripture does not say, “and to seeds,” meaning many, but “and to your seed,” meaning One, who is Christ.

halves.title: Born in Bethlehem
halves.quote: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, who are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come forth for Me One to be ruler over Israel—One whose origins are of old, from the days of eternity.

halves.title: Born in Bethlehem
halves.quote: “In Bethlehem in Judea,” they replied, “for this is what the prophet has written: ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah, for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of My people Israel.’”

halves.title: The root of Jesse
halves.quote: On that day the Root of Jesse will stand as a banner for the peoples. The nations will seek Him, and His place of rest will be glorious.

halves.title: The root of Jesse
halves.quote: And once more, Isaiah says: “The Root of Jesse will appear, One who will arise to rule over the Gentiles; in Him the Gentiles will put their hope.”

halves.title: The King rides in on a donkey
halves.quote: Rejoice greatly, O Daughter of Zion! Shout in triumph, O Daughter of Jerusalem! See, your King comes to you, righteous and victorious, humble and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

halves.title: The King rides in on a donkey
halves.quote: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet: “Say to the Daughter of Zion, ‘See, your King comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.’”

halves.title: The King rides in on a donkey
halves.quote: Finding a young donkey, Jesus sat on it, as it is written: “Do not be afraid, O Daughter of Zion. See, your King is coming, seated on the colt of a donkey.”

halves.title: A new covenant
halves.quote: Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah. It will not be like the covenant I made with their fathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt—a covenant they broke, though I was a husband to them,” declares the LORD. “But this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the LORD. I will put My law in their minds and inscribe it on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people. No longer will each man teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, ‘Know the LORD,’ because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest, declares the LORD. For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.”

halves.title: A new covenant
halves.quote: But God found fault with the people and said: “Behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah. It will not be like the covenant I made with their fathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt, because they did not abide by My covenant, and I disregarded them, declares the Lord. For this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their minds and inscribe them on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people. No longer will each one teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest. For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.”

halves.title: A new covenant
halves.quote: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is poured out for you.

halves.title: A prophet like Moses
halves.quote: The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers. You must listen to him.

halves.title: A priest like Melchizedek
halves.quote: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

halves.title: A priest like Melchizedek
halves.quote: And in another passage God says: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

halves.title: A priest like Melchizedek
halves.quote: For it is testified: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

halves.title: A light in Galilee
halves.quote: Nevertheless, there will be no more gloom for those in distress. In the past He humbled the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, but in the future He will honor the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations: The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.

halves.title: A light in Galilee
halves.quote: to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles— the people living in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.”

halves.title: God's chosen Servant, with the Spirit on Him
halves.quote: “Here is My Servant, whom I uphold, My Chosen One, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will bring justice to the nations.

halves.title: God's chosen Servant, with the Spirit on Him
halves.quote: “Here is My Servant, whom I have chosen, My beloved, in whom My soul delights. I will put My Spirit on Him, and He will proclaim justice to the nations.

halves.title: Anointed to free the captives
halves.quote: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and freedom to the prisoners, to proclaim the year of the LORD’s favor and the day of our God’s vengeance, to comfort all who mourn,

halves.title: Anointed to free the captives
halves.quote: “The Spirit of the Lord is on Me, because He has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to proclaim liberty to the captives and recovery of sight to the blind, to release the oppressed, to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.” Then He rolled up the scroll, returned it to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fixed on Him, and He began by saying, “Today this Scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.”

halves.title: His side pierced
halves.quote: Then I will pour out on the house of David and on the people of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and prayer, and they will look on Me, the One they have pierced. They will mourn for Him as one mourns for an only child, and grieve bitterly for Him as one grieves for a firstborn son.

halves.title: The shepherd struck, the sheep scattered
halves.quote: Awake, O sword, against My Shepherd, against the man who is My Companion, declares the LORD of Hosts. Strike the Shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered, and I will turn My hand against the little ones.

halves.title: The shepherd struck, the sheep scattered
halves.quote: Then Jesus said to them, “This very night you will all fall away on account of Me. For it is written: ‘I will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’

halves.title: David's son and David's Lord
halves.quote: A Psalm of David. The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”

halves.title: David's son and David's Lord
halves.quote: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I put Your enemies under Your feet.”’

halves.title: The cornerstone in Zion
halves.quote: So this is what the Lord GOD says: “See, I lay a stone in Zion, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation; the one who believes will never be shaken.

halves.title: The cornerstone in Zion
halves.quote: as it is written: “See, I lay in Zion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense; and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”

halves.title: The cornerstone in Zion
halves.quote: For it stands in Scripture: “See, I lay in Zion a stone, a chosen and precious cornerstone; and the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”

halves.title: Silent as a lamb
halves.quote: He was oppressed and afflicted, yet He did not open His mouth. He was led like a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is silent, so He did not open His mouth.

halves.title: Silent as a lamb
halves.quote: The eunuch was reading this passage of Scripture: “He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is silent, so He did not open His mouth. In His humiliation He was deprived of justice. Who can recount His descendants? For His life was removed from the earth.” “Tell me,” said the eunuch, “who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?” Then Philip began with this very Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.

halves.title: Numbered with the transgressors
halves.quote: Therefore I will allot Him a portion with the great, and He will divide the spoils with the strong, because He has poured out His life unto death, and He was numbered with the transgressors. Yet He bore the sin of many and made intercession for the transgressors.

halves.title: Numbered with the transgressors
halves.quote: For I tell you that this Scripture must be fulfilled in Me: ‘And He was numbered with the transgressors.’ For what is written about Me is reaching its fulfillment.”

halves.title: Not abandoned to the grave
halves.quote: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.

halves.title: Not abandoned to the grave
halves.quote: So also, He says in another Psalm: ‘You will not let Your Holy One see decay.’

halves.title: He took up our infirmities
halves.quote: Surely He took up our infirmities and carried our sorrows; yet we considered Him stricken, struck down by God, and afflicted.

halves.title: He took up our infirmities
halves.quote: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: “He took up our infirmities and carried our diseases.”

halves.title: By His wounds we are healed
halves.quote: But He was pierced for our transgressions, He was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was upon Him, and by His stripes we are healed.

halves.title: By His wounds we are healed
halves.quote: He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. “By His stripes you are healed.”

halves.title: No sin, no deceit
halves.quote: He was assigned a grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in His death, although He had done no violence, nor was any deceit in His mouth.
